content.text: Experienced Defense Against Criminal Charges in TexasHave you been arrested for a criminal offense? At Underwood & Associates, our Wichita Falls criminal defense attorney is here to stand by your side. Our commitment to justice, extensive experience, and relentless advocacy make us your dedicated partners in the pursuit of a fair and just legal resolution. Call Underwood & Associates today at (972) 944-8571 or contact us online to schedule a consultation with our criminal defense attorney in Wichita Falls. Do I Need a Criminal Defense Attorney? Facing criminal charges is a serious matter that necessitates thoughtful consideration of legal representation. When contemplating whether to engage a defense lawyer, several key factors come into play: Understanding the Legal Terrain: Navigating the legal system requires an in-depth understanding of its nuances. We have the knowledge and experience needed to comprehend the complexities of criminal law, ensuring that your case is handled with the utmost expertise. Protection of Your Rights: A criminal defense attorney serves as your advocate, working tirelessly to safeguard your constitutional rights. Whether it's protecting against unlawful searches, ensuring due process, or preserving your right to a fair trial, our legal team stands firmly by your side. Mitigating Potential Consequences: Criminal charges can have severe repercussions, from fines and probation to incarceration. We formulate strategic defense plans to mitigate potential consequences, striving for the most favorable outcome for our clients. Negotiating with Prosecutors: Skillful negotiation is often a pivotal aspect of criminal defense. We excel in engaging with prosecutors to explore potential avenues for resolution, whether through plea bargains, reduced charges, or alternative sentencing options. Litigation Experience: We possess the skills and experience to present a compelling defense in the courtroom. We approach each case with a commitment to thorough preparation and effective advocacy. Criminal Defense Cases We Handle Some of the criminal cases we handle include: Domestic Violence: Domestic violence allegations can have serious consequences, impacting not only your legal standing but also your personal and professional life. We are experienced in handling domestic violence cases with sensitivity and diligence. We work tirelessly to protect your rights and strive to achieve the best possible outcome for your situation. Drug Crimes: Drug-related charges demand a nuanced understanding of state and federal laws. We defend clients facing drug offenses, from possession to trafficking. We can scrutinize evidence, challenge procedures, and construct a comprehensive defense tailored to your case. DWI (Driving While Intoxicated): Being charged with DWI can have very severe consequences, including license suspension, fines, and potential imprisonment. We are experienced at challenging DWI charges, examining sobriety test results, and exploring every avenue to build a robust defense strategy for your case. Expunctions and Non-disclosures: A criminal record can have lasting effects on your life, impacting employment opportunities and personal relationships. We understand the importance of a clean slate and strive to guide you through the legal process with efficiency and expertise. Probation Revocations: If you're facing probation revocation, we are well-versed in navigating the complexities of probation laws. We advocate on your behalf, presenting a compelling case to minimize the potential consequences and work toward a favorable resolution. Sex Crimes: Sex crime allegations require a delicate and comprehensive defense strategy. We handle sex crime cases with the utmost professionalism and dedication. We understand the sensitivity of these matters and prioritize safeguarding your rights and reputation. Contact Our Wichita Falls Criminal Defense Attorney Today Don't navigate the legal system alone if you are facing criminal charges in Wichita Falls. At Underwood & Associates, we are here to provide the expert legal representation you need. Contact us today to schedule a consultation with our experienced Wichita Falls criminal defense lawyers. We are committed to protecting your rights and ensuring the best possible outcome for your case. Trust in us for effective, results-driven legal representation.
